visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins in a bright, modern restaurant interior. A man in a light-colored dress shirt and dark blue tie sits at a table, smiling and flashing a peace sign toward a baby seated in a green stroller next to him. Warm pendant lights hang from the ceiling, and other diners are visible in the soft-focus background. (2) The scene shifts to a celebratory moment at home. The man and a woman with blonde hair, both wearing orange horn-like headbands, hold a small white cake with two yellow candles in front of the baby. The lighting is warm and domestic, emphasizing a cozy family atmosphere. (3) A montage of the baby’s daily life follows, featuring the child playing on a colorful mat with a toy piano, looking out from a white crib with a Winnie the Pooh mobile, and crawling on a large hotel bed with white linens. The camera uses a mix of static shots and gentle handheld movements. (4) Later, the baby is shown in a daycare setting. One scene captures a teacher kneeling to feed the baby with a spoon, while another shows the child playing in a blue ball pit with the man. A Japanese handwritten note on a door is highlighted, suggesting a supportive educational environment. (5) The final sequence shows the mother sitting at a table under a bright lamp, writing on small cards. She holds three yellow envelopes. Various arts and crafts, including handprints and Halloween-themed decorations, are displayed on a floor alongside rabbit-themed communication books.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 兒子要升上日本保育園一歲班了. (2) [Subtitle]: 我是在東京育兒的RU醬. (3) [Subtitle]: 麻糬在6個月大時就開始上日本的保育園(托嬰). (4) [Subtitle]: 見學了很多家最後選擇了現在這家保育園 也很幸運地抽中了! (5) [Subtitle]: 辦手續時園長偷偷跟我說 因為我見學時就一直說很喜歡這裡 她很開心我抽中了. (6) [Subtitle]: 看到我的名字的時候好興奮 這種脫離正式流程的話語真的好貼心(o'ω'o). (7) [Subtitle]: 剛開始喝奶不順利 老師跪著餵用湯匙一口一口餵. (8) [Subtitle]: 還因為兒子對聲音敏感 老師在教室門口貼紙條請大家進出注意聲響. (9) [Subtitle]: 這些明明很麻煩的事情老師卻主動做 只為了給孩子最好的照顧環境. (10) [Subtitle]: 每天帶孩子出門踏青接收新刺激 在教室做勞作一起跳舞唱歌. (11) [Subtitle]: 到現在麻糬看到老師會要老師抱抱 真切地感受到他在保育園也被好好地愛著. (12) [Subtitle]: 升上一歲班後老師都會換 我寫了卡片給每一位0歲班的老師. (13) [Subtitle]: 謝謝老師對兒子的付出和照顧 也謝謝老師成為父母最有利的後盾. (14) [Subtitle]: 謝謝你們讓一個還不會表達的小小人感受到被理解、被照顧、被喜歡. (15) [Subtitle]: 我想這就是我最想給他的世界 有安全感的開始 有被珍惜的日常. (16) [Subtitle]: 謝謝你們 陪他走過人生的第一年. (17) [Variety]: 聯絡簿. [Variety]: 勞作們. [Logo]: @ru_story_japan.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio track opens with a gentle, finger-picked acoustic guitar melody accompanied by a soft, lyrical piano. A male narrator begins speaking in a calm and sentimental tone, explaining the child's milestone of moving to a one-year-old class in a Japanese daycare. The mix is clear, prioritizing the voice-over. (2) As the narration moves into a retrospective about the daycare's meticulous care, the music maintains its sentimental and major-key warmth. Very soft bubble-like sound effects and light bells accent the appearance of variety text on the screen, adding a polished, social-media-friendly feel to the production. (3) The concluding portion of the track features the narrator expressing profound gratitude toward the teachers. The music slightly swells in emotional intensity but remains grounded in its acoustic, folk-like simplicity. There is no background noise or interference, resulting in a high-fidelity, studio-grade listening experience throughout the video.
